items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: we went to Chicago with a sextet... we had Remo Palmer; we added a guitar to it.

ctx.x: Aaron wasn't drafted, but then we hung around and was doing a few dates and then we formed a -- we went to Chicago with a sextet with drums, bass, piano, clarinet and vibraphone. And we did that for awhile, we had Remo Palmer; we added a guitar to it.
